scoring_scheme.name: half_ppr_te_premium_superflex
scoring_scheme.description: 0.5 points per reception for every position plus a 0.5/rec tight end premium (so 1.0/rec for TEs), superflex roster format.

adjustments: Justin Fields (10754): not in source, skipped
Mac Jones: fully synthetic row, absent from source (comp-median, see SYNTHETIC_PLAYERS)
Samaje Perine: half_ppr 3yr 80 -> 97 (1yr exceeded the retirement-discounted 3yr; future seasons zeroed)

fields.rank: Pool rank, 1..N, by points_3yr descending (ties broken by the provider's dynasty rank). Unique and gap-free.
fields.positional_rank: Rank within position under the same ordering.
fields.player_id: Provider player id. The only unique key — names collide.
fields.sleeper_id: Sleeper's player id (a string), for looking this player up against the league on Sleeper's API. Null when no unambiguous match exists in their player dump.
fields.name: Player name.
fields.bye_week: Team bye week; null for unsigned players.
fields.points_3yr: Three-year projected fantasy points under this league's scoring: 0.5/rec with a 0.5/rec TE premium. Copied from the provider column that prices that rate exactly (TE: ppr, others: half_ppr). Never below points_1yr: a retirement-discounted 3yr cell is raised to the 1yr value (see 'adjustments').
fields.points_1yr: One-year projected points, same scoring and same source columns. The gap between this and points_3yr is the provider's implied growth: the ranker prices bench upside off the years-2-3 pace, (points_3yr - points_1yr) / 2. A genuine 0 (e.g. a stashed rookie) is kept as 0.
fields.adp: Superflex ADP as an overall pick number in the source's 12-team draft (its round.pick value decoded: 2.03 -> 15). Past pick 540 the source's tail is noise, i.e. 'effectively undrafted' rather than a real slot.
